body_lead: Maharashtra’s minister of Information and Technology Ashish Shelar on Friday declared that Maharashtra will become the first state in India to establish an Artificial Intelligence University. Shelar said, “This will be the state government’s landmark project that will be executed in collaboration with the department of Higher and Technical Education.
